build_pipeline_feature_selection: build a scikit-learn pipeline that chains SelectKBest feature selection with LinearSVC classifier
create_classification_dataset: create a synthetic binary classification dataset with make_classification specifying feature counts and random state
split_dataset_train_test: split a dataset into training and testing subsets using train_test_split with a fixed random state
select_top_k_features: select the top k most discriminative features using SelectKBest with f_classif ANOVA test
inspect_pipeline_coefficients: inspect pipeline classifier coefficients and inverse-transform them to map back to original feature space
